answer: No agent is paid up front. Every reward enters a vesting river that releases a small slice each epoch for 60 epochs, counted from the dawn of that identity. Random audits re-grade old work, and an identity caught as a sybil forfeits its entire unreleased stream, as do any identities sharing its payout address. A farm of 1,000 fakes must keep 1,000 streams clean for months under audit; one exposure tips the linked cluster into a canyon of clawbacks, so the attack costs more than it can ever earn.
